scope: Theorem 7.5 (Uniform pin estimate) of the manuscript “Spontaneous magnetization in the quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet” (preprints/Spontaneous-magnetization-in-the-quantum-Heisenberg-ferromagnet-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 271 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c9083e5eb7a9d6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer d ≥ 3 and integer slot multiplicity ℓ ≥ 1, there exist L ≥ max{2d, ℓ, 4} and p∗ ∈ (0, 1/4) with the following property. Let 0 < p ≤ p∗ and β ≥ 5p−11/10. In any finite cube Λ, choose a finite circular time grid containing zero and of mesh at most p4d. Let E consist of D0 and any subset of the slot points on this grid. Then every nonempty test T at a single grid time, disjoint from E and satisfying (7.1), obeys PE(T ⊆ BE) ≤ p|T| . (7.26) In particular, with p = p∗ and β0 = 5p −11/10 ∗ < ∞, for every finite β ≥ β0, every cube, and every slot j at time zero, PD0 (j ∈ BD0 ) ≤ p∗. (7.27) The constants depend only on d and ℓ.
